left with the underlying presheaf, componentwise. -/
def sheafComposeUnitIso :
    𝟭 (Sheaf J A) ≅ sheafCompose J e.functor ⋙ sheafCompose J e.inverse :=
  NatIso.ofComponents
    (fun F => (fullyFaithfulSheafToPresheaf J A).preimageIso
      (Functor.isoWhiskerLeft F.obj e.unitIso :
        F.obj ≅ (F.obj ⋙ e.functor) ⋙ e.inverse))
    (fun {F G} f => by
      apply Sheaf.hom_ext
      ext U
      simp
      exact e.unit.naturality (f.hom.app U))

the left with the underlying presheaf, componentwise. -/

  NatIso.ofComponents

    (fun {F G} f => by
      apply Sheaf.hom_ext
      ext U
      simp
      exact e.counit.naturality (f.hom.app U))

the pinned Mathlib has no such equivalence and no `IsEquivalence` instance

section PreservesSheafification

universe v₁ u₁ v₂ u₂ v₃ u₃

variable {C : Type u₁} [Category.{v₁} C] (J : GrothendieckTopology C)
  {A : Type u₂} [Category.{v₂} A] {B : Type u₃} [Category.{v₃} B]

instance preservesSheafification_of_equivalence (e : A ≌ B)
    [J.HasSheafCompose e.inverse] :
    J.PreservesSheafification e.functor := by
  -- transfer of the local-bijectivity characterization of `J.W` along the
  -- whiskering adjunction of `e.congrRight`
  constructor
  intro P₁ P₂ f hf
  show J.W ((e.congrRight (E := Cᵒᵖ)).functor.map f)
  intro Q hQ
  have hQ' : Presheaf.IsSheaf J (Q ⋙ e.inverse) :=
    GrothendieckTopology.HasSheafCompose.isSheaf Q hQ
  letI adj := (e.congrRight (E := Cᵒᵖ)).toAdjunction
  have key : (fun (g : (e.congrRight (E := Cᵒᵖ)).functor.obj P₂ ⟶ Q) =>
        (e.congrRight (E := Cᵒᵖ)).functor.map f ≫ g) =
      (adj.homEquiv P₁ Q).symm ∘ (fun (g : P₂ ⟶ Q ⋙ e.inverse) => f ≫ g) ∘
        (adj.homEquiv P₂ Q) := by
    funext g
    exact (Equiv.eq_symm_apply _).mpr (adj.homEquiv_naturality_left f g)
  rw [key]
  exact ((adj.homEquiv P₁ Q).symm.bijective.comp (hf _ hQ')).comp
    (adj.homEquiv P₂ Q).bijective

sheafification (the mirror of `preservesSheafification_of_equivalence`,
via `e.symm`). -/

    [J.HasSheafCompose e.functor] :

variable (A : Type u) (B : Type v) [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Algebra A B]

/-- The free `B`-module on `n`-tuples of elements of `B`; the tuple `t`
stands for the formal `n`-form `dt₀ ∧ … ∧ dt_{n-1}`, and a Finsupp value
`single t s` for `s • dt₀ ∧ … ∧ dt_{n-1}`. -/
abbrev DRFree (n : ℕ) : Type v :=
  (Fin n → B) →₀ B

/-- The de Rham relation set, mirroring `KaehlerDifferential.kerTotal`
slot-wise, plus alternation: in each slot `i` we impose additivity, the
Leibniz rule and vanishing of constants from `A`; and any tuple with two
equal entries dies. -/
def relSet (n : ℕ) : Set (DRFree B n) :=
  {w | (∃ t : Fin n → B, ∃ i : Fin n, ∃ x y : B,
          w = single (update t i x) 1 + single (update t i y) 1
            - single (update t i (x + y)) 1) ∨
       (∃ t : Fin n → B, ∃ i : Fin n, ∃ x y : B,
          w = single (update t i y) x + single (update t i x) y
            - single (update t i (x * y)) 1) ∨
       (∃ t : Fin n → B, ∃ i : Fin n, ∃ a : A,
          w = single (update t i (algebraMap A B a)) 1) ∨
       (∃ t : Fin n → B, ∃ i j : Fin n, i ≠ j ∧ t i = t j ∧ w = single t 1)}

/-- The `B`-submodule of relations defining the degree-`n` de Rham term. -/

  Submodule.span B (relSet A B n)

the free `B`-module on `n`-tuples modulo the slot-wise Kähler relations and
alternation. `DR A B 0 ≃ B` (`drZeroEquiv`) and `DR A B 1 ≃ Ω[B⁄A]`
(`drOneEquiv`). -/

  DRFree B n ⧸ rel A B n

`n`-tuple `t`. -/

  Submodule.Quotient.mk (single t 1)

/-- The Leibniz rule in each slot. -/

  rw [gen, gen, gen, ← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul, ← Submodule.Quotient.mk_smul,

  rw [gen_update_add] at key
  rw [update_comm hij (x + y) x t, update_comm hij (x + y) y t] at key

  have h1 : gen A B (update (update t j x) i x) = 0 :=

/-- Per-tuple slot-0 assembly map for the differential: `s ↦ [s, t]`
(that is, `s • dt ↦ ds ∧ dt`). -/
def dAux {n : ℕ} (t : Fin n → B) : B →ₗ[A] DR A B (n + 1) where
  toFun s := gen A B (Fin.cons s t)
  map_add' s s' := gen_cons_add A B s s' t
  map_smul' a s := by rw [RingHom.id_apply, gen_cons_smul]

/-- The pre-differential on the free module: `single t s ↦ [s, t]`. -/
def preD (n : ℕ) : DRFree B n →ₗ[A] DR A B (n + 1) :=
  Finsupp.lsum ℕ (dAux A B)

@[simp] theorem preD_single {n : ℕ} (t : Fin n → B) (s : B) :
    preD A B n (single t s) = gen A B (Fin.cons s t) := by
  rw [preD, Finsupp.lsum_single]; rfl

/-- The `B`-submodule of elements all of whose `B`-multiples `preD` kills.
This is the "killer submodule" device: `preD` is only `A`-linear, but this
carrier is a `B`-submodule, letting a generator check kill the whole
`B`-span of the relations. -/
def killer (n : ℕ) : Submodule B (DRFree B n) where
  carrier := {x | ∀ b : B, preD A B n (b • x) = 0}
  zero_mem' := fun b => by rw [smul_zero, map_zero]
  add_mem' := fun {x y} hx hy b => by rw [smul_add, map_add, hx b, hy b, add_zero]
  smul_mem' := fun c x hx b => by rw [smul_smul]; exact hx (b * c)

/-- The crux: the relations are killed (as a `B`-submodule) by `preD`. -/
